name: Liechtensteinklamm gorge
why: Walkways and tunnels through one of the deepest gorges of the Alps, the Grossarler Ache roaring 300 m below its walls.
book: Ticket at the entrance (May to October).

points.name: Liechtensteinklamm entrance
points.note: The ticket hut where the gorge opens.

points.name: Liechtensteinklamm
points.note: The spiral stair and waterfall at the end of the gorge.
